title: [Remote] Product Engineer na JotPsych
body:
### About the company

JotPsych makes software for behavioral health clinicians. Our scribe has drafted more than 3.1 million patient notes and cuts administrative time by about 90%. We're now expanding from the note into the revenue cycle: billing, audit, prior-auth. We're a small team, and we build through AI coding agents all day.

### Company website

https://jotpsych.com

### Job description

The decisions about what you build get made in a meeting you aren't in. You've shipped features you could tell were wrong the day the ticket arrived. You'd like to be the one who talked to the customer first.

You'll take features from a customer conversation to production, UI to backend to database to prompt. That half of the job you already know.

The other half is deciding what to build. You'll sit in on calls with clinicians and billers, then run your own. You'll write down what you think we should build and why, and we'll argue with it.

Early on we'll be fairly prescriptive. The first projects come from us, with our reasoning. You have the technical half, and we're going to teach you the rest: taste, craft, and how to manage a product. As your read on our users holds up, more of the deciding moves to you. We want that to happen fast, though not in week one.

What you'd own in the first 90 days:

- Ship 3 to 5 user-facing features on the clinical and billing surfaces
- Sit in on customer calls every week. By day 90, run your own
- Do one stretch of forward-deployed work: stay with one practice's problem until it's fixed for them
- Write the evals for everything you ship
- Fix one piece of shared infrastructure the rest of us lean on
- Disagree with us about one product decision, and bring what you heard from customers

### Requirements

**Required:**
- Senior. You've shipped production software somewhere real, and you know how prod breaks and how to fix it.
- Fluent spoken and written English. You'll talk with clinicians and billers in the US every week.

**Nice to have:**
- Low ego. You're senior as an engineer and new at product. When a product call of yours is wrong we'll say so, and you'd rather hear it.
- Already talking to users. Nobody asked you to. Support tickets, sales calls, the people using your side project.
- Insight. Given a problem, you lay out the options, work back from the goal, and say no to the attractive option that doesn't serve it. This is the thing we screen hardest for.
- Sharp. You learn a new system in days, and you find the flaw in an argument, your own included.
- Fast and exact. You cut a feature into pieces small enough to ship in days, and you check each piece before anyone else sees it.
- AI-pilled. Claude Code, loops, a software factory, whatever is next. You mostly whisper to your computer.

### Benefits

Full-time and remote, on contract.

### Salary range

USD 5,000 to USD 8,000 / month (Latin America)

### Level

Senior

### Contract type

Contractor, PJ

### Work model

Remote

### Location

Latin America

### How to apply

Apply at https://jotpsych.com/careers-engineer-remote?utm_source=engineer-remote-backendbr: fill out the short form, then call the number the page shows you. No resume.

### Confirmations

- [x] This issue contains a single job opening.
- [x] The job is backend (or fullstack with a backend focus).
- [x] This is not an AI training, data annotation or model evaluation gig.

title: [Remoto] Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Pleno - White Label e Plataforma - Mimix AI
body:
### Sobre a empresa

A Mimix AI desenvolve uma plataforma de software para gerenciar operações white label de clientes do setor de robótica. A plataforma organiza a publicação de tarefas, o acompanhamento de envios e os repasses aos participantes.

### Site da empresa

https://www.mimix-ai.xyz

### Descrição da vaga

Buscamos uma pessoa desenvolvedora backend pleno para manter os serviços e as integrações das operações white label da Mimix AI e implementar novas funcionalidades da plataforma. O trabalho envolve escrever código, testar mudanças e investigar falhas em produção.

- Manter e evoluir o backend e as integrações das operações white label.
- Acompanhar a operação dos clientes white label, investigar problemas e encaminhar ou implementar os ajustes necessários.
- Colaborar no desenvolvimento, nos testes e na entrega de novas funcionalidades da plataforma Mimix.

### Requisitos

**Obrigatórios:** experiência com desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações backend, APIs e integrações. Capacidade de investigar falhas em produção e comunicar os próximos passos com clareza.

**Desejáveis:** experiência com plataformas white label ou produtos que atendem a vários clientes.

### Nível

Pleno

### Regime de contratação

PJ

### Modelo de trabalho

Remoto

### Localização

Brasil

### Como se candidatar

Fale com Marcos pelo [WhatsApp: +55 11 93201-4665](https://wa.me/5511932014665) ou escreva para [caldasvieiramarcos@gmail.com](mailto:caldasvieiramarcos@gmail.com). Inclua seu LinkedIn, GitHub ou currículo e conte em poucas linhas sobre uma funcionalidade que você ajudou a colocar em produção.

### Confirmações

- [x] Esta issue contém uma única vaga.
- [x] A vaga é para backend (ou fullstack com foco em backend).
- [x] Não é vaga de treinamento de IA, anotação de dados ou avaliação de modelos.

title: [Joinville/SC] Back-end ou Full Stack Developer (Node.js + React)
body:
### Sobre a empresa

Join our team of talented software engineers and be at the forefront of building innovative, AI-driven solutions. At LRA Ventures and Shipix, you'll have the opportunity to create groundbreaking products from scratch, tackling diverse challenges and making a significant impact across various industries. 

We are dedicated to empowering businesses with intelligent tools that drive competitiveness, profitability, and sustainability. While our roots are in transforming the logistics sector, we are expanding our expertise to develop cutting-edge, AI-powered systems for a range of new projects. 

We foster a collaborative environment where deep technological expertise meets creative problem-solving. As part of our international team, based in the Netherlands and Brazil, you will play a key role in building and launching new applications, and shaping the future of our technology.


### Site da empresa

https://lra-ventures.com/

### Descrição da vaga

As a Full Stack Developer, you will be responsible for building new features on our platform, delivering complete end-to-end solutions. From concept to implementation, you will be involved in every stage of feature development.
You can have more experience as a backend or frontend developer, but you should be comfortable working across the full stack when necessary.

Responsibilities:
- Develop and implement new features for our platform using Node.js and React.
- Work closely with the tech lead, other developers, and the Product Manager.
- Participate in Agile team activities, including daily async check-ins, weekly planning and DDD meetings.
- Ensure high code quality through code reviews and collaborative development practices.
- Contribute to a steep learning curve by sharing knowledge and best practices with team members.


### Requisitos

Requirements:
- 4+ years of experience in software development.
- 2+ years of experience in backend development with Node.js and TypeScript.
- 2+ years of experience in frontend development with React.
- Experience in building SaaS products.
- Experience working in software house or outsourcing 
- English speaker

Preferred Experience:
- Experience developing solutions for serverless and AWS lambda.
- Experience working remotely and exceptional organizational skills.
- Motivation and enthusiasm for tackling new project challenges from start to production.


### Benefícios

_No response_

€ 1500 - € 3000 (Euros)

### Nível

Sênior

Joinville, SC

title: [Belo Horizonte ou São Paulo, Brasil] Early Career Software Engineer, People with Disabilities na Google
body:
## Descrição da vaga: Esta é uma vaga de um parceiro da plataforma Coodesh, ao candidatar-se você terá acesso as informações completas sobre a empresa e benefícios. Fique atento ao redirecionamento que vai te levar para uma url [https://coodesh.com](https://coodesh.com/jobs/early-career-software-engineer-people-with-disabilities-181722150?utm_source=github&utm_medium=backend-br-vagas&modal=open) para realizar a candidatura. 👋

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and promotes affirmative actions as an employer. 

This requisition is a pipeline effort to generate the People with Disabilities community interest in opportunities at Google. All candidates with disabilities will be evaluated for this role in compliance with the provisions of Article 93 Federal Labor Law 8.213/91. Please provide documentation that attest your disability. Please merge it in your resume PDF.

O Google tem orgulho em ser um local de trabalho inclusivo.

Somente as candidaturas de Pessoas com Deficiência (PcD) serão avaliadas para essa vaga, em conformidade com o disposto no artigo 93 da Lei Federal do Trabalho de número 8.213/91.

Pedimos, por gentileza, que a pessoa candidata envie o currículo em inglês, e forneça documentação que comprove sua deficiência. A documentação pode ser enviada junto ao currículo, no mesmo PDF.

Please submit your resume in English - we can only consider applications submitted in this language.

In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.


Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Belo Horizonte, State of Minas Gerais, Brazil; São Paulo, State of São Paulo, Brazil.
